_doc: The film's soundtrack (real-sound skill): professional recordings only, credited in CREDITS.md. Built by <skill>/scripts/mix.py from this file and one fragment per category in audio/design/ (each designer owns one fragment; names are prefixed with the category). Keys starting with _ are comments. Reference: <skill>/references/design-format.md.
_buses_doc: Fader rides that shape the arc (film seconds, dB). Write a reason for every ride here: e.g. the music dips 6 dB under the typing (2.0-3.6), comes back for the transition, lifts 1.5 dB into the drop, and resolves 3 dB down under the logo so the sting reads. Keep steps on a musical splice or under a transient.
_master_doc: -14 LUFS integrated for web / social (YouTube, X, LinkedIn normalise to about -14). Ceiling 0.77 linear (-2.3 dBFS) leaves room for the AAC encode (measure about -1 dBTP after the mux). Lower the target to -15 / -16 only for a reason you write here (e.g. a dynamic orchestral track whose tutti the limiter would squash at -14).
